capacityRules: transport.capacity must be >= party.adults + party.children + party.elderly
team users should prefer 16-seat road transfer or grouped transfer
haLongTransferRules: If origin=HAN, road transfer should be primary; flights are not required
If arrival airport is HPH or VDO, include ground transfer to Ha Long
If hotel.zone includes Đảo Rều, always include resort boat transfer
If bayCondition=rough or windLevel=strong, add 30-60 minutes pier/boat buffer
If road traffic=high, avoid tight same-day cruise after Hanoi pickup
cruiseRules: If bayCondition=rough or cruiseStatus=weather_hold, replace cruise with museum/indoor pool/spa
If elderlyMode=true, avoid Ti Top viewpoint and Sung Sot Cave stairs unless explicitly requested
If kayakAllowed=false, replace kayak with onboard viewing deck or cave-free cruise route
For family relaxed pace, schedule cruise on the best weather day, not necessarily day 1
pacingRules: family with elderly: avoid more than 2 medium/high walkLevel activities in same day
childTired=true: insert rest block within next 60 minutes
elderlyMode=true: prefer indoor pool, museum, resort boat priority, low walkLevel
weatherRules: rainProb >= 60: deprioritize weatherSensitive=true unless indoor backup exists nearby
heavy_rain: replace water park/outdoor/cruise with museum/indoor pool/spa
very_hot: avoid outdoor activity between 12:00 and 15:30
strong wind: monitor cruise, resort boat, Queen Cable Car
queueRules: queueMin >= 40: suggest fastpass or alternate attraction
queueMin >= 55: avoid unless user interest is thrill/theme_park and pace=active
resort boat queue >= 25: suggest priority boarding or shift dinner to island restaurant
voucherRules: expires within 24h: surface voucher in plan if applicable and user tier is eligible
F&B voucher: match restaurant.acceptsVoucher and minSpend
late checkout: recommend for afternoon road return or evening flights
cruise voucher: only recommend if bayRiskForecast not high
